# SYNESIS_E138 — Error

## Description

extraction: `field_name` (ITEM) outside the phase scope.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
`extraction`: the field `field_name` belongs to scope ITEM.
  PHASE ANNOTATIONS produces SOURCE and ITEM fields; PHASE ONTOLOGY, ONTOLOGY fields.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **PhaseScopeMismatch**: `phase`, `field_name`, `field_scope`
